notes.title: Zoroastra Announcement
notes.content:
[b]Greetings,[/b]

I wanted to announce how things will go with Zoroastra since most people who were interested haven't gotten any information.

The project is still in development and might need a few more years to be finished. I simply can't deliver a product that is incomplete.

I'm really sorry for those who were excited to see Zoroastra be released this summer.

If you have any ideas or questions, feel free to share them on this forum.

Have a nice day!
